risk_and_execution.protection: Protective buy-stop activates at next scheduled market-minute start after entry-minute start, including when that next minute is missing. Never delay to first observed minute. In entry minute protection is intentionally inactive; report high>=S as entry-bar exposure evidence, not fabricated stop.
risk_and_execution.stop_gap: Nextactualopen>=S executesatopen; otherwise high>=S atS in declaredintrabar scenario
risk_and_execution.terminal: For a live position after protective checks, exit at close of complete final scheduled minute [actualsessionclose-1minute,actualsessionclose). Missing exit/held-minute => unknown trajectory/open unvalued asset, never zero or delete.
risk_and_execution.path_claim: One effective minute-price trajectory per case/method/delay. OHLC high/low ordering is irrelevant because protection starts following minute and there are no targets/reentries. No path robustness claim.
risk_and_execution.single_entry: One pending parent per case/method/delay, maximum one entry. No partial fills, no targets, no reentry after stop or EOD. No later entry attempts after cancellation, invalidity or unknown trajectory.
risk_and_execution.pending_expiry: At actualsessionclose-15minutes cancel unfilled parent before processing that minute. Last eligible entry-minute starts close-16minutes. Calendar cancellation event occurs even without an observed bar; a gap before cancellation while parent active still makes prior possible fill unknown.
minute_priority: Validate chronological expected-grid/data for this arm; missing minute while active pending or holding ends identification as unknown, with known events retained
At expiry timestamp cancel unfilled parent before its minute; closed/invalid arms remain closed/invalid
Activate parent at frozen open+delay; entry can occur only before expiry
For a position entered earlier, protection active at scheduled entry-minute+1: check gapopen>=S first, else high>=S atS
For a new entry, protection intentionally inactive for the entry minute; retain stop-level crossing flag
If final scheduled minute and position survives protective check, EOD close exit
risk_and_execution.missing_mid_path: Any absent/invalid/conflicting minute while pending active or position held can hide entry/stop; retain event prefix, q0/R0, gap bounds and unresolved position/order. Set exit/profit/R/borrowstress N/A for affected arm; no assumed nofill, postponed protection, imputed prices, or actualhaltexplanation. Missing after known closed position or after clean pending cancellation does not invalidate that closed/no-fill arm.

costs.charges: fees=q*entryprice*bps/10000 + q*exitprice*bps/10000 on actual proxy-filled notional; originalR0 never renormalized after gap fill. For short: transactionAdjustedR=(q*(entryprice-exitprice)-fees)/R0.
costs.borrow: Mandatory fixed0 and20%APR stress for every cost cell. Charge entrynotional=q*entryprice times APR times1/365: one calendar-day minimum for this intraday same-session convention. Actual locates/ETB/rate remain unknown; assumed stress is not actual net short return.
costs.borrow_stress_formula: stressR=(q*(entryprice-exitprice)-fees-q*entryprice*APR/365)/originalR0; missing/invalid/nofill stay their frozen states, no imputed R
costs.attribution: 100USD planned-risk q0 differs across methods. Report trigger, activation delay, gap slippage, risk distance, integer quantity/R0, entry/exit notional and dollar fees separately; this is risk-budget matched, not equal-share pure price comparison.
